{{nihongo|'''Kumano Shrine (Iwadono, Minamiizu Town)'''|熊野神社(南伊豆町岩殿)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].
